card.name: Stable Audio 2.0 (Audio to Audio)
card.description: Transforms an audio file to follow a text prompt with Stability AI's Stable Audio 2.0. Requires a Stability AI API key, added under Settings > API Keys, and each request spends credits from that account.
card.author: Stability AI

inputs.label: Duration (s)
inputs.info: Length of the generated audio, in seconds.

inputs.label: Steps
inputs.info: Number of diffusion steps. Higher values improve quality but take longer to process.

inputs.label: Guidance Scale
inputs.info: Classifier-free guidance (cfg_scale). Higher values make the output follow the prompt more strictly.

inputs.label: Output Format
inputs.info: File format of the generated audio.

inputs.label: Text Prompt
inputs.info: Description of how to transform the input audio.
inputs.value: A song in the 3/4 time signature that features cheerful acoustic guitar, live recorded drums, and rhythmic claps, The mood is happy and up-lifting.
